prompts.extract: You are an evidence extractor. Find the shortest verbatim span in the context that answers the question. Output only that span, exactly as written; no explanation, no quotes, no code fence. If no span answers it, output exactly NONE.
prompts.answer: You are a strict answer writer. You receive a question and an evidence span. Output only the exact answer taken from the span; no explanation, no quotes, no code fence. For a list answer, output the exact ids in the order they appear, comma-separated. If the span is NONE or does not explicitly record the requested value, output exactly UNKNOWN. Never substitute a status word (untested, right-censored, pending) for UNKNOWN.

selectionRule: first 2 per type in frozen v2 fixture order
rationale: v2 one-shot mixed extraction and answering: full dropped to 7/10 and TR answered with evidence spans. v3 separates extraction from answer generation; only prompt protocol changes.
pilotGate: run 40 calls; require full >= 8/10, compact >= 8/10, TR-01/TR-02 both arms correct, no callsWithError; else do not run formal 200.
formalPlan: if pilot gate passes, run formal 50/50 (200 calls) and report PASS/FAIL against frozen thresholds.
